endpoints.coordinateEvidenceDetail: az_usfs_white_bridge_picnic_site_access_9740_20260918 usfs-edw-recreation-opportunities-objectid-9740-recid-77748: Forest Service EDW feature 9740 / recreation area 77748 identifies the White Bridge Picnic Site at 34.549539,-111.850602. Its official description states that the developed public picnic site provides access to the Verde River and non-motorized boating; its linked site photos document the trail from the picnic area to the river. This is the current recreation-site access marker and is about 63 feet from the former route point, which matches the Friends of the Verde access-table coordinate. The Forest Service paddle guide also identifies White Bridge RAP but lists a waypoint about 545 feet north and cautions that its map is for reference and accuracy is not guaranteed. Prefer the Forest Service recreation-site feature for the managed public access-area pin. The feature is not a surveyed wet toe.
endpoints.note: Stored coordinate matches the named authoritative access-area control (az_usfs_white_bridge_picnic_site_access_9740_20260918 usfs-edw-recreation-opportunities-objectid-9740-recid-77748) on Verde River; this confirms the public access site, not the exact water-edge point. Confirm the water-edge location and carry before paddling.
